description: KozyGrid helps you turn ideas and images into editable chunky blanket patterns.  Create a design in ChatGPT, prepare it for KozyGrid, open it in the editor, and refine stitches, colors, size, and layout before downloading your pattern kit.  You can also browse existing KozyGrid blanket templates when you want a ready-made starting point.

defaultPrompt: Create a simple desert sunset chunky blanket design with a cactus, warm colors, and bold shapes.
Turn this design into a chunky blanket pattern.
Show me some baby blanket designs for chunky blankets
